header.job: Build an LED circuit on a breadboard

events.text: verbal explanation of power bus strip layout
detailed explanation of LED polarity and internal structure
struggles slightly aligning resistor lead into breadboard tie point

steps.title: Connect ground wire to rail
steps.description: Insert black jumper wire from Arduino ground pin into the blue negative power bus rail on the breadboard.
key_points: Ensure wire is seated firmly in the negative rail pinhole

transcript.text: Right hand positions the pin of the black wire over the top blue rail near column 60
Right hand presses the black wire pin into the top blue rail hole at column 60
Right hand releases the black wire

steps.title: Connect 5V power wire to rail
steps.description: Insert red jumper wire from Arduino 5V pin into the red positive power bus rail on the breadboard.
key_points: Verify 5V connects to red positive rail, not adjacent ground

transcript.text: Right hand brings a red jumper wire towards the breadboard
Right hand inserts the red jumper wire pin into the positive (red) power rail next to the black wire
Right hand releases the red jumper wire

steps.title: Inspect power rails layout
steps.description: Trace and verify power and ground continuity along the breadboard outer rails.

transcript.text: Left hand touches the top power rail near column 50
Right hand index finger points to column 30 and traces across the upper rows toward column 60
Left hand touches the top power rail near column 45
Right hand index finger traces the top power rail from the center gap to the right end
Left hand index finger points to the center break in the top power rail
Left hand index finger sweeps left along the top power rail
Left hand index finger traces back and forth across the center gap of the top power rail
Left hand index finger points to the polarity markings at the top left of the breadboard
Left hand index finger points to the polarity markings at the bottom left of the breadboard
Right hand finger points to the bottom right end of the power rail
Both hands grip the left and right sides of the breadboard
Both hands release the breadboard

steps.title: Separate jumper wires
steps.description: Pick ribbon cable from wire supply and peel individual male-to-male jumper wires off the ribbon.
key_points: Pull wires apart smoothly without tearing pin crimp housings

transcript.text: Both hands hold a multi-colored ribbon cable of jumper wires.
Both hands separate the connector ends of several wires from the ribbon.
Both hands turn the ribbon cable over.
Left index finger points along the wires of the ribbon cable.
Right index finger points to the breadboard.
Both hands peel a strip of five jumper wires off the ribbon cable.
Both hands place the ribbon cable aside and set the separated jumper wires above the breadboard.
Right hand slides the Arduino Uno board closer to the breadboard.
Right index finger touches the Arduino Uno board.
Right index finger traces along the top power rail of the breadboard.
Left hand and right hand point to the upper and lower sections of the breadboard.

steps.title: Inspect red LED polarity
steps.description: Pick red 5mm LED and inspect lead lengths to identify longer anode lead and shorter cathode lead.
key_points: Longer leg is positive anode; flat notch on casing indicates cathode

transcript.text: Left hand picks up an LED from the table to the left
Both hands hold the LED upright close to the camera to inspect internal electrodes
Right index finger points at the LED casing
Both hands rotate the LED horizontally to inspect lead lengths
Left hand holds the LED upright above the breadboard
Right index finger points along the LED leads to show polarity

steps.title: Insert red LED into breadboard
steps.description: Position and press red LED leads into terminal rows across separate column strips on the breadboard.
key_points: Insert leads into distinct rows to prevent short circuiting

transcript.text: Left hand positions the LED above columns 24 and 25 of the upper breadboard area
Left hand inserts the LED pins into the breadboard holes at rows 24 and 25
Right index finger points towards the LED pins along row 25
Left hand releases the LED
Left and right index fingers point to the corresponding columns on the lower half of the breadboard
Right index finger points directly to the inserted LED
Left hand presses the LED firmly into the breadboard holes
Both hands withdraw from the breadboard

steps.title: Form resistor leads
steps.description: Pick through-hole 330 ohm resistor and bend axial wire leads 90 degrees downward.
key_points: Bend leads to match breadboard hole pitch spacing

transcript.text: Right hand bends one lead of the resistor downward at a 90-degree angle
Both hands rotate the resistor
Right hand bends the other lead downward at a 90-degree angle to create a U-shape
Right hand takes the resistor from the left hand
Right hand holds the resistor leads over the breadboard holes to check spacing
Right hand places the resistor on the table
Left hand picks up the resistor from the table
Right hand takes the resistor and positions it above the breadboard

steps.title: Insert resistor for red LED
steps.description: Insert one resistor lead into the negative ground rail and the second lead into the LED cathode terminal row.
key_points: Ensure solid seating in tie points without bending leads

transcript.text: Right hand presses the LED into the breadboard while left hand holds the breadboard
Right hand releases the LED
Right hand picks up the resistor from the breadboard
Right hand inserts one leg of the resistor into the top negative rail and the other leg into column 26
Right hand pushes the resistor down and releases it
Right index finger points along the top negative rail to the resistor and the LED

steps.title: Pick red jumper wire
steps.description: Reach and grasp red male-to-male jumper wire from the bench.

transcript.text: Left hand inserts the pin of the red jumper wire into hole 21E of the breadboard
Left hand presses the LED bulb down firmly into the breadboard
Left hand releases the LED
Left hand reaches for the free end of the red jumper wire
Left hand grasps and lifts the free end of the red jumper wire
Right hand grasps the pin connector of the red jumper wire
Right hand releases the red jumper wire

steps.title: Connect power to red LED
steps.description: Plug one end of red jumper wire into the positive power rail and the other end into the LED anode row, illuminating the red LED.
key_points: Verify LED lights up immediately upon connection

steps.title: Pick and inspect yellow LED
steps.description: Pick 5mm yellow LED from bin and verify polarity of the leads.

transcript.text: Left hand positions a clear LED onto the breadboard
Left hand releases the clear LED
Right hand brings a clear LED into view
Left hand picks up the clear LED from the breadboard
Both hands hold up and inspect the two LEDs side by side
Left hand lowers and sets its LED down on the table
Left hand points with its index finger at the lit red LED on the breadboard

steps.title: Insert yellow LED into breadboard
steps.description: Insert yellow LED leads into adjacent available rows on the breadboard.

transcript.text: Left hand holds the bottom edge of the breadboard to steady it
Right hand inserts the leads of the yellow LED into the upper section of the breadboard
Right hand releases the LED and pulls away
Left hand releases the breadboard and pulls away

steps.title: Pick jumper wire for yellow LED
steps.description: Reach and grab jumper wire from wire stock.

transcript.text: Right hand grasps one pin of the red jumper wire
Right hand positions the pin over row 29 on the top half of the breadboard
Right hand inserts the pin into row 29 of the breadboard
Right hand releases the pin
Right hand presses the inserted pin into place with index finger
Right hand grasps the other end of the red jumper wire

steps.title: Connect power jumper for yellow LED
steps.description: Insert jumper wire connecting positive power rail to yellow LED anode column.
key_points: Align pin into correct column matching yellow LED anode

transcript.text: Right hand moves the red jumper wire pin toward row 24 of the breadboard
Right hand inserts the pin into row 24 of the breadboard, in line with the anode of the clear LED
Right hand releases the jumper wire pin
Right hand reaches for the clear LED at row 24
Right hand presses down on the clear LED to seat it in the breadboard
Right hand releases the clear LED

steps.title: Insert resistor for yellow LED
steps.description: Insert current-limiting resistor between ground rail and yellow LED cathode row, illuminating the yellow LED.
key_points: Verify yellow LED illuminates when ground completes circuit

transcript.text: Right hand grasps the yellow LED on the breadboard
Right hand presses the yellow LED firmly into the breadboard until it lights up
Right hand releases the yellow LED
Right hand points at the yellow LED
Right hand reaches for a red jumper wire on the right
Right hand grasps the red jumper wire
Right hand moves the red jumper wire to the breadboard
Right hand inserts the pin of the red jumper wire into column 31 of the breadboard
Right hand releases the red jumper wire

steps.title: Insert resistor for green LED
steps.description: Insert 330 ohm resistor connecting negative rail to green LED column.
key_points: Ensure resistor lead connects to common ground rail

transcript.text: Both hands bend the leads of a resistor.
Both hands release the resistor onto the breadboard.
Right hand picks up the resistor from the breadboard.
Left index finger rests on the breadboard near column 12.
Right hand inserts one lead of the resistor into row 13 and the other into the top negative rail.
Right hand presses the resistor down into the breadboard.

steps.title: Insert green LED into breadboard
steps.description: Insert green LED leads into powered row and resistor row, completing the circuit to illuminate green LED.
key_points: Confirm correct polarity so green LED lights up

transcript.text: Right hand positions the green LED over the breadboard
Both hands insert the green LED into the breadboard holes
Both hands release the green LED and breadboard

steps.title: Inspect complete LED circuit
steps.description: Inspect and verify all three LEDs (red, yellow, green) are continuously lit.
key_points: Verify all connections are secure and stable

transcript.text: Inspect the red, yellow, and green LEDs illuminated on the breadboard

notes:
Handheld camera movements and variable lighting throughout. The video opens with a conceptual demonstration and explanation of breadboard internal bus and column connections (00:09 - 02:16) prior to the physical circuit assembly beginning at 02:17.
Layout: Components are arranged loosely on the workbench surface around the central breadboard.
